Hey Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the engineering team is excited to proceed. We're finalizing procurement but have run into an internal approval step in IT that pushed our PO sign-off into next week. Our legal and procurement folks confirmed the PO will be issued, but there's a short gap where our sandbox/production trial will hit its token limits and some scheduled demos could break.

Attached is a draft PO and the SOW so you can see where we are in the pipeline. Can Redwood hold the current demo environment live (or issue a small temporary credit) for 7–10 days while we get the finance stamp? If helpful, I can escalate internally — the blocker is a last security review taking place on Wednesday.

We really want to keep momentum with the pilot and the execs are watching. Appreciate any help you can offer to avoid a hard stop.

Warmly,

Alex —

Really appreciate the heads-up and the PO draft. Good news: we can provision a short "stay-warm" allowance while procurement wraps up. Specifically I can authorize a 7-day extension of the current trial window and issue a 5,000-token safety credit out of our pilot stewardship pool today, conditional on the PO draft and an expected PO date.

Cc'ing Priyom (billing/operations) and Lauren (CS lead) to make this operational. Priyom — can you provision the 7-day window + 5k token credit for Clearsight once we have the PO draft on file? I'll need a quick confirmation back to Alex and a note on any additional steps if the PO slips beyond 7 days.

Alex, if you can share the expected PO date and the internal approver name, that helps us decide whether to extend further. If the security review pushes it beyond 10 days we'll re-evaluate, but we want to keep things moving.
